text:
sara_finance: Hey all, I'm seeing a mismatch between the AWS Marketplace statement for Apr 2024 (MP-2024-04-00047) and the payout that hit our bank. Statement shows $38,912.45, payout was $35,701.20. Anyone else tracking this?
eli_ops: Noted. Do we have the statement PDF and the payout remittance ID?
sara_finance: I uploaded the statement to /finance/marketplace/MP-2024-04-00047.pdf and the payout remittance from the bank is REM-2024-05-06-AWS.
juan_cloud: Quick thought: could be tax withholding or marketplace fee holdback. AWS sometimes withholds VAT in certain regions. But difference $3,211.25 seems large for VAT alone.
marta_sales: Also check whether any reseller credits/chargebacks applied. We had one customer refund in that month processed via a reseller.
billing-bot: Automated: AWS Marketplace payout processed (REM-2024-05-06-AWS) for payout amount $35,701.20. Details: https://console.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/merchant/operations/payouts/REM-2024-05-06-AWS
alex_engineering: I can pull marketplace usage logs and reconcile SKUs to statement line items. Which dataset should I query?
sara_finance: Use the BigQuery export: project billing-exports.marketplace. Look for table marketplace_usage_202404. We need sku-level billed_usd and transaction_type.
eli_ops: I'll run a quick query and post totals. Example query I used before:
```
SELECT sku, SUM(billed_usd) AS total_usd, COUNT(*) AS tx_count
FROM `billing-exports.marketplace.marketplace_usage_202404`
WHERE vendor_account = 'redwood-inference'
GROUP BY sku
ORDER BY total_usd DESC;
```
eli_ops: Results (top lines):
- sku: rw-inf-hosted-1, total_usd: 21,390.10
- sku: rw-inf-dedicated-1, total_usd: 12,128.90
- sku: rw-inf-support-credits, total_usd: 1,393.45
eli_ops: Sum of billed_usd from export = 34,912.45 (this is ~ $1,000 less than the AWS statement number on the PDF).
sara_finance: So we have three numbers: BigQuery export = $34,912.45, AWS statement = $38,912.45, bank payout = $35,701.20. Weird.
juan_cloud: The $1,000 delta between export and statement could be reserved balances/holds or delayed transactions. Do we have any marketplace reserved host credits (e.g., reserved instance refunds) in Apr?
marta_sales: There was a reseller onboarding that month that used deferred billing terms. Could be reseller commission/internal dealer fee not in our export. I'll pull reseller agreement.
alex_engineering: Another angle: currency conversions. Any sales in EUR or GBP that AWS converted to USD at a rate that appears on statement but not in our BigQuery?
sara_finance: Good call — statement line 42 shows "Currency Conversion Adj: -$500.00". That partially explains the gap but still not full amount.
billing-bot: Automated: Marketplace adjustment recorded: ADJ-2024-04-28-REFUND for -$1,200.00 (customer refund via reseller).
marta_sales: That's the refund I mentioned. If AWS adjusted us -$1,200 and there is a currency adj -$500, that explains $1,700. But we still have ~ $1,511.80 unexplained between statement and payout.
eli_ops: Could there be a withheld tax amount? I see on the statement an item "Withholding Tax (EU): -$1,511.80" on line 88.
sara_finance: That matches the remaining gap. So full breakdown: AWS statement $38,912.45 minus withholding $1,511.80 minus refund $1,200.00 minus currency adj $500.00 = $35,700.65 (rounding) -> payout $35,701.20 (30c rounding difference).
juan_cloud: Great — sounds like a reconciliation. We should document this in the finance ticket and attach the BigQuery export, statement PDF, and bank remittance.
sara_finance: I'll open FIN-2024-153 and add this thread + calculations. Can someone paste the exact statement lines (IDs) for the withholding and currency adj so I can reference them?
eli_ops: Withholding line id: L-88 (Withholding Tax (EU) -1511.80). Currency adj id: L-42 (Currency Conversion Adj -500.00). Refund id: ADJ-2024-04-28-REFUND (-1,200.00).
sara_finance: Perfect. I'll close the loop with accounting and mark as reconciled once FIN-2024-153 updated. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
marta_sales: I'll follow up with the reseller contact to confirm they passed through the refund correctly.
juan_cloud: One action item for engineering: add sku-level marketplace billing export check to the monthly billing-runbook so we catch these sooner.
alex_engineering: Will add a short script to produce a reconciliation CSV and post to /finance/recon/monthly.
sara_finance: Closing note: total variance explained, rounding within $1, payout matches after adjustments. Marking resolved for now.
